mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET `credit_score` = GREATEST( 0, LEAST( 200, ROUND(IFNULL(`credit_score`, 100) * POW(0.98, DATEDIFF(NOW(), `credit_last_update`) / 30)) ) ), `credit_last_update` = NOW(), `update_time` = NOW() WHERE `is_deleted` = 0 AND `credit_last_update` IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), `credit_last_update`) > 1
